summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Investigation summary (read-only; no files changed)  I traced the full watchlist path before writing this plan:  - **Client → API:** `client/src/lib/api.ts` sends every request with `credentials: "include"`, so the session cookie always goes along.
